categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in three segments: intelligent power grid fault monitoring and automation products, switched reluctance motor (SRM) drive systems, and energy storage systems including integrated photovoltaic-storage solutions. It focuses on power system secondary equipment, industrial motor manufacturing, and user-side energy storage applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include wide-area traveling wave fault location, transient signal acquisition without dead zones, AI-based fault diagnosis, high-sensitivity grounding fault protection, and advanced motor control algorithms for switched and synchronous reluctance motors. Production relies on in-house R&D with ERP-managed 'make-to-order' manufacturing, emphasizing digitalization, modular design, and integration of IoT and AI technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major state-owned power grid companies such as State Grid Corporation of China and China Southern Power Grid, railway system operators, and industrial sectors including textile, forging, coal mining, petrochemical, and machinery manufacturing. The company also serves commercial and industrial users for energy storage solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales cover all major regions in China including East, Central, North, South, Northeast, Northwest, and Southwest China, with products also exported to over 30 countries and regions internationally. The company has subsidiaries and branches in multiple Chinese provinces and a wholly-owned subsidiary in the UK.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the power automation and motor manufacturing supply chain, focusing on product design, manufacturing, and direct sales to end users and system integrators. It also engages in energy storage system integration and service provision.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening technology leadership in power grid fault monitoring and automation, expanding switched reluctance motor applications towards direct-drive and servo systems, and scaling user-side energy storage business with AI-enhanced energy management. R&D focuses on product upgrades, AI integration, industrial internet applications, and virtual power plant technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of customized products including intelligent grid equipment, motor drive systems, and energy storage solutions. The company also earns income from technical services, maintenance, and energy management solutions. Government subsidies and investment income contribute to overall revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position domestically in intelligent power grid fault monitoring and switched reluctance motor drive systems, with market share exceeding 65% in SRM drives. It competes with international firms like Siemens, ABB, and Schneider in automation products, and is recognized as a national champion in specialized manufacturing sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 420 million, a 22.13% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 30.5 million, up 139.79%. R&D investment accounted for 11.5% of revenue. The company maintains steady growth with expanding market penetration and improved profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes proprietary core technologies, high precision and reliability in fault detection, energy-efficient motor solutions without rare earth materials, and integrated smart energy management systems. Its products offer superior fault location accuracy, AI-enabled diagnostics, and flexible energy storage configurations, providing customers with enhanced operational efficiency, safety, and sustainability.
